name: Lundquist College of Business

said: An early application increases your chances of obtaining merit-based scholarships and graduate employment offered by the Lundquist College of Business.
deadlines.src: Oregon MBA how to apply page

tuition_usd.stat: estimated 2026-27 annual tuition, Oregon resident, excluding fees (non-resident 46872; UO graduate student fees 2835 per year itemized separately)

notes: Lundquist does not publish an aggregate MBA class profile: the class_profile_url redirects to a 2023-24 flipbook of individual student bios with no statistics, and the admissions pages state only a 3.0 GPA and 24 months work experience expectation. The college career outcomes dashboard (mohr.uoregon.edu/outcomes) pools undergrad and graduate programs and reports no MBA-specific employment rate or salary. Eugene campus confirmed on the program page. US News rank not included: usnews.com returned 503.
